entities.summary: Tân Định Church or Tân Định Parish Church is a Roman Catholic church in Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam. Its formal name is the Church of the Sacred Heart of Jesus. Even though it is in District 3, the parish shares its name with neighbouring District 1's Tân Định ward as of Tân Định was the place name of a former village that the church was also included.
